description: 成长内容：词族进化 + 句型迁移

family.example: Our city is clean and beautiful.
family.exampleCn: 我们的城市干净又美丽。

family.example: I clean my room every day.
The street cleaner works very hard.
Don't make the street dirty.
Let's clean up the park.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: clean既可以作形容词也可以作动词。加-er变成人cleaner（清洁工）。反义词是dirty（脏的）。

family.example: Health is more important than money.
It can keep us healthy.
We should eat healthily.
Junk food is unhealthy.
Exercise helps us keep healthy.
family.exampleCn: 运动帮助我们保持健康。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: 名词health加-y变成形容词healthy，变y为i加-ly变成副词healthily，加un-前缀变成反义词unhealthy。

family.example: Don't throw rubbish on the ground.
He threw a banana skin on the ground.
family.exampleCn: 他把一块香蕉皮扔在了地上。

family.example: Don't throw away useful things.
family.exampleCn: 不要把有用的东西扔掉。

family.example: He feels sick and wants to throw up.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: throw的过去式是threw，属于不规则变化。throw away是「扔掉」，throw up是「呕吐」，意思完全不同。

family.example: Be careful not to fall.
Willy slipped and fell down.
The leaves have fallen.
He fell down and hurt his knee.
The boy fell off his bike.
family.exampleCn: 那个男孩从自行车上摔了下来。

family.example: I fell asleep quickly last night.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: fall的过去式是fell，过去分词是fallen，都是不规则变化。fall down是摔倒，fall off是从高处摔落。

family.example: We should keep our city clean.
family.exampleCn: 我们应该保持城市清洁。

family.example: The zookeeper takes care of animals.
family.exampleCn: 动物园饲养员照顾动物。

family.example: Running helps us keep healthy.
family.exampleCn: 跑步帮助我们保持健康。

family.example: Please keep quiet in the library.
Keep trying and you will succeed.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: keep的用法很多：keep + adj.（保持某种状态）、keep doing（一直做）、keep sb. + adj.（使某人保持某种状态）。

family.example: What's your plan for the weekend?
I plan to go to the park.
Good planning is important.
I use a daily planner.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: plan既作名词也作动词。注意plan的现在分词是planning（双写n加-ing）。

sentencePatterns.pattern: What's your plan for + 时间/事情?
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: What's your plan for the weekend, Su Hai?
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 苏海，你周末有什么计划？
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: What's your plan for...? 是询问某人计划的常用句型。for后面可以接时间（weekend, holiday, summer vacation）或事情。

transferExamples.english: What's your plan for the holiday?
What's your plan for tomorrow?
What's your plan for the birthday party?
transferExamples.chinese: 你对生日派对有什么计划？

transferExamples.english: What's your plan for the summer vacation?

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + will / 'll + 动词原形
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: I'll go plogging with my family.
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 我要和家人一起去慢跑捡垃圾。
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: 一般将来时：will + 动词原形，表示将来要做的事情或计划。口语中常用缩写：I'll, you'll, he'll, she'll, we'll, they'll。

transferExamples.english: I'll go to the park tomorrow.
We'll have a party next week.
She'll visit her grandma this weekend.
transferExamples.chinese: 她这周末要去看望奶奶。

transferExamples.english: They'll meet at the school gate.
transferExamples.chinese: 他们将在学校门口集合。

sentencePatterns.pattern: Don't + 动词原形 + 其他!
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: Don't throw the banana skin on the ground!
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 不要把香蕉皮扔在地上！
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: 否定祈使句的结构：Don't + 动词原形。用来表示禁止或警告，语气比较强烈。

transferExamples.english: Don't run in the classroom!
Don't eat too much junk food!
Don't be late for school!
Don't talk loudly in the library!
transferExamples.chinese: 不要在图书馆大声说话！

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + should / shouldn't + 动词原形
sentencePatterns.patternCn: 某人应该/不应该做某事
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: We should keep our city clean.
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 我们应该保持城市清洁。
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: should表示「应该」，shouldn't（should not）表示「不应该」，都是情态动词，后面接动词原形。用来提出建议或表达责任。

transferExamples.english: You should do your homework first.
We should help each other.
You shouldn't watch TV too much.
We shouldn't waste water.

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + make + 宾语 + 形容词
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: make + 宾语 + 形容词，表示「使……变得怎么样」。类似的动词还有keep（保持），结构相同：keep + 宾语 + 形容词。

transferExamples.english: The good news makes me happy.
Reading makes us smart.
Exercise makes us strong.
Smoking makes people unhealthy.

growthExercises.question: 选择正确的词填空：Running can help us keep ______. (health)
growthExercises.explanation: keep + 形容词，表示保持某种状态。keep healthy 保持健康。

growthExercises.question: 选择正确的词填空：He ______ down from the tree yesterday. (fall)
growthExercises.explanation: yesterday是过去时间，要用过去式。fall的过去式是fell，不规则变化。

growthExercises.question: 用所给词造句：you / plan / what's / for / the holiday
growthExercises.answer: What's your plan for the holiday?
growthExercises.explanation: What's your plan for...? 询问某人关于某事的计划。

growthExercises.question: 翻译：我们应该保持教室干净。
growthExercises.answer: We should keep our classroom clean.
growthExercises.explanation: should + 动词原形；keep sth. + adj. 保持某物某种状态。

growthExercises.question: 翻译：不要在河里游泳！
growthExercises.explanation: 否定祈使句：Don't + 动词原形。
